invariants.rationale: The 'name' property from the JsonValue is directly set as the layer's name.
The layer's opacity is set based on the JsonValue's 'opacity' property, defaulting to 1.0f.
The layer's visible property directly matches the 'visible' property from the JsonValue, defaulting to true.
The offsetX is parsed and set from the JsonValue 'offsetx' property, defaulting to 0.
The layer's tint color is set to the converted value from the JsonValue's 'tintcolor' property, defaulting to '#ffffffff'.
